# ReelMatch

> ReelMatch is a movie and TV discovery app that helps friends, couples, and families agree on what to watch. Users swipe trailers Tinder-style, sync watchlists with friends, and get a "match" when everyone likes the same title — ending the endless scrolling and debating before movie night.

ReelMatch is built and maintained by Digital Space Agency. It is free to download on iOS and Android, with an optional Pro subscription that unlocks streaming-provider filters, genre filters, and instant TV launch.

## Core features

- Swipe to Watch: swipe right on a trailer to add it to your watchlist, swipe left to pass. The more you swipe, the better the recommendations get.
- Sync with Friends & Family: connect with friends, view each other's watchlists, and find common ground.
- Match for Movie Night: when two or more people swipe right on the same title, it becomes a match — the app's core answer to "what should we watch tonight?"
- Instant TV Launch (Pro): launch a matched movie or show directly on the TV without extra steps.
- Provider & Genre Filters (Pro): filter recommendations by streaming service (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, etc.) and genre.
- Release-year filtering: limit recommendations to the last 5, 10, or 15 years, or view everything.
- Group matching: designed for group movie nights where getting 3-4 people to agree is normally difficult.

## Who it's for

Couples, friend groups, and families who spend more time deciding what to watch than actually watching it, and who are subscribed to one or more streaming services.
